description: S3 bucket is open to the public (ACL grant to AllUsers)
remediation: Make the ACL private and turn on Block Public Access

description: S3 bucket has no default encryption enabled
remediation: Turn on default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS)

description: S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled at bucket level
remediation: Enable all four Block Public Access settings
Enable bucket versioning so old copies can be recovered

description: SSH port 22 is open to the whole internet (0.0.0.0/0)
remediation: Allow only trusted IP ranges, or use a VPN/bastion host

description: ALL ports are open to the whole internet (0.0.0.0/0)
remediation: Delete the rule and allow only the ports you really need

description: Disk (EBS volume) is not encrypted at rest
remediation: Copy the disk as an encrypted volume and replace it

description: Administrator user has no MFA (second login step)
remediation: Enrol an MFA device for the user

description: User has full admin rights (*:*) via AdministratorAccess
Access key is older than 90 days (2479 days)
remediation: Create a new key, update the apps, delete the old key

description: Weak account password policy (shorter than 14 characters)
remediation: Require 14+ characters, mixed types, and expiry

description: Database is reachable from the internet (PubliclyAccessible)
remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible to false and move to private subnet

description: Database storage is not encrypted at rest
remediation: Restore a snapshot into an encrypted instance

description: No active multi-region CloudTrail (no activity log)
remediation: Create a multi-region trail and start logging

description: Encryption key rotation is turned off
